add_brands.says: Birmingham medallist and insignia maker; Royal Warrant 2008; supplies the Central Chancery of the Orders of Knighthood since 1975; BAMS President's Medal and Marsh Award 2011 for medallic art; makes the Lonsdale Belt and FIFA Club World Cup trophy

Milan maker of trophies, plaques and medals (formerly Bertoni, Milano); made the FIFA World Cup Trophy (Gazzaniga, 1971), UEFA Champions League, Europa League, Super Cup and Africa Cup of Nations trophies

La Chaux-de-Fonds photogravure stamp printer (1880-2001), 'Master Stamp-Printers'; printed for over 65 postal administrations incl. most Swiss commemoratives, Liechtenstein, Luxembourg; Swiss PTT sent photogravure work to Courvoisier after its own attempts were unsatisfactory. Not Courvoisier cognac (J7)
formerly Dix Noonan Webb (1990); London auction house for coins, medals and paper money; largest numismatics auctioneer in London, over 400,000 lots sold

A. H. Baldwin & Sons, est. 1872, one of the largest and longest established numismatic dealers; auctions in London, New York, Hong Kong. HOMONYM: register 'Baldwin' (B8) is a lock and hardware brand, not this firm (the harvest notes wrongly treat it as known)
printed (on paper) the Curaçao and Sint Maarten 200 gulden note, IBNS Bank Note of the Year 2025. Distinct from register 'Crane' (steam inhalers, H2)
Reserve Bank of Australia subsidiary that printed the Philippines 1000 piso polymer note, IBNS Bank Note of the Year 2022
Orell Füssli Security Printing, Zurich, printed the Swiss 9th-series notes; Switzerland won IBNS Bank Note of the Year 2016 and 2017
Amiens (1831); catalogue and album since 1896; its stamp catalogue is the French reference and one of the international references with Stanley Gibbons, Michel and Scott; sells albums under its brand
the leading stamp catalogue of the German-speaking world since 1910, ~400,000 printed a year; published by album maker Schwaneberger Verlag, Munich
English gold- and silversmith that designed/made or restores the FA Cup, Ryder Cup, Six Nations and Webb Ellis Rugby World Cup, Louis Vuitton Cup, FIBA World Cup trophy
Birmingham Jewellery Quarter medallist since 1819; made the 1908 London Olympic medals and the 1896 replacement FA Cup; still mints English Football League medals

tier_changes.n: Heritage Auctions / In the Game Trading Cards / Dart Flipcards / Parkhurst Products / Cartamundi
tier_changes.why: register holds them under F2/E1; Heritage began as a coin auctioneer and In the Game, Dart Flipcards and Parkhurst Products are sports/non-sports trading-card makers (Category:Trading card companies), so F3 is their home or a cross-tag; Cartamundi stays E1 (playing cards, prints TCGs)

tier_changes.n: Mennica Polska / Mitsubishi Materials / Bradbury Wilkinson / Waterlow & Sons
tier_changes.to: cross_tag F3 (same companies, HOMONYM MASKING check)
tier_changes.why: Mennica Polska (F5 transit cards) is the same Warsaw mint company as the COTY winner; Mitsubishi Materials (C4 metal clay) is the same company as the LBMA refiner; Bradbury Wilkinson and Waterlow (F5) are the same stamp/banknote printers. Not homonyms: cross_tag rather than new rows
